known_secrets.text: Several years ago Tarek woke in the middle of the night and checked the stone heirloom.
When asked about it, he refused to explain.
Luma once found an old note hidden among Tarek's belongings: 'If the Song is broken, the Key must remain hidden.'
She secretly kept the note. Tarek believes it was lost.

unknowns: What happened during the city's fall
